conventions.S: full Hecke algebra Z[T_l (l <= Sturm + 1, l != q, l <= 97), U_q] of S_kk(Gamma_0(q)) (S06-C4's generator set minus primes > 97, the HACS descent cap); realised on (+)_s Z[gens]*1 in K_s over the orbits s that can meet m
conventions.T_l: HACS descent(N, kk-2, P).module_Z() free block F (T_l b_j = sum_i F_ij b_i), exact over Z, in HACS's basis (record words: basis rule iso_dixon/v3, saturation det_pm1)
conventions.U_q: q-new orbit: a_q = eps q^{(kk-2)/2}, eps from HACS level_n U_q charpolys (subset sum); level-one orbit g: U_q = y with y^2 - a_q(g) y + q^{kk-1} = 0, a_q(g) from HACS module_Z at level 1
conventions.eta: eta_f(q) = eta(S_m, lam_f) (S06-C4, defect.congruence.defect, base change to O)
conventions.eta_new: eta_f(1, q) = eta(S'_m, lam_f), S' = q-new quotient
conventions.eta_B: weight k: v_p det of the Gram matrix G_w (w_x weights) on the q-new orbit lattice at m (S06-C5 Python and the native BrandtSym file, cross-checked; Hsieh Rem 7.3); weight k+(p-1): the ring-theoretic congruence ideal of the definite Hecke algebra at the weight-k m (native file, m_from_weight_k.etaB_ring; the Gram is not eta^B there since p <= n)
conventions.t_f_q: v_p(a_q(g)^2 - q^{k-2}(q+1)^2), a_q(g) from HACS (level-one T_q)
conventions.status: computed / bound / open; record words quoted verbatim

data.status_words: computed / open (with reason); 'not determined' = the native definite block is not resolved into Q_p-orbits

census.bounds: q prime, 2 <= q <= 50; k even, 2 <= k <= 20; p prime, k < p < 200, p >= 5, p != q, p !| q^2 - 1

trivial_cells.reason: every (q, k, p) with q <= qmax prime, k <= kmax even, k < p < pmax prime, p >= 5, p != q, p !| q^2 - 1 is examined; a cell is skipped as trivial when the generic charpoly is squarefree mod p (every m is then a single Q_p-orbit with eta^B = 1) and no level raising congruence with the level-one form is possible (p !| a_q(g)^2 - q^{k-2}(q+1)^2); emitted cells keep only the blocks with a congruence or an old congruence
